helpText: The unique Settings Asset ID used by ItemFlavors. If you want to reference an ItemFlavor via playlist, just copy and paste the whole SAID00000000123 string.
Determines which autogen persistence slot to use for the statref for this challenge - note that two challenges cannot share the same autogen slot (assert will fire in client on dev).
This must match the stat ref of the second stat referenced by the challenge
If set, give the item rewards for each tier using GRX_GiveSequenceRewardEasy instead of GRX_QueueGiveRewards. Alphanumeric and underscore only.
Each tier is something to accomplish. When completed the challenge advances to the next tier. The reward is given at the end of all tiers.
